outcome: Spica casting and/or operative treatment for DDH
cohort: 945 infants with DDH treated at Tampere University Hospital between 1998-2018
finding: Breech presentation was strongly associated with Ortolani positivity, but not with the need for spica casting or operative treatment, while positive family history and female sex were associated with more severe DDH requiring spica casting and/or operative treatment.
mod_finding: While not specified as a primary finding, breech presentation was not found to be associated with needing more invasive treatment.
